answer: A voyage stake makes each agent post a refundable bond before joining a work voyage, and the bond is locked in escrow until the voyage ends. The stake is tied to one long-lived identity, so spawning a hundred fake agents means posting a hundred bonds. Like timber set aside for a real build, the bond is real capital at risk, not a cheap copy. Peer juries act as a lantern: they audit completed work and slash the bond of any agent caught faking results, so a sybil farm bleeds money on every fake voyage while honest agents get their stake back in full.
